service: camping-demo-cron

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  region: us-west-2
  timeout: 900
  memorySize: 1024
  logRetentionInDays: 14
  environment:
    CRON_TOKEN: ${env:CRON_TOKEN}
    RUN_MAX_MINUTES: 55
    SUPABASE_URL: ${env:SUPABASE_URL}
    SUPABASE_KEY: ${env:SUPABASE_KEY}
    NODE_ENV: production
  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Resource:
        - arn:aws:lambda:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:function:${self:service}-${sls:stage}-worker
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - logs:CreateLogGroup
        - logs:CreateLogStream
        - logs:PutLogEvents
      Resource: arn:aws:logs:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:*

functions:
  health:
    handler: lambda/health.handler
    description: Health check endpoint for the camping demo cron service
    events:
      - httpApi:
          method: GET
          path: /healthz
    package:
      patterns:
        - lambda/health.mjs

  trigger:
    handler: lambda/trigger.handler
    description: HTTP trigger to start the fetchAvailability worker function asynchronously
    environment:
      WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-worker
    events:
      - httpApi:
          method: GET
          path: /cron/fetch-availability
      - httpApi:
          method: POST
          path: /cron/fetch-availability
    package:
      patterns:
        - lambda/trigger.mjs
        - lambda/package.json

  worker:
    handler: lambda/worker.handler
    description: Worker function that executes the fetchAvailability.js script
    timeout: 900
    memorySize: 2048
    reservedConcurrency: 1
    deadLetterQueue:
      targetArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - WorkerDLQ
          - Arn
    environment:
      NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=1792'
    package:
      patterns:
        - scripts/recreation-gov/**
        - lambda/worker.mjs
        - lambda/package.json
        - '!scripts/recreation-gov/node_modules/**'
        - '!**/*.test.*'
        - '!**/*.md'

resources:
  Resources:
    WorkerDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-worker-dlq
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600 # 14 days

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

custom:
  serverless-offline:
    httpPort: 3001
